method: Native layer-11 outline parsed with pour_geometry.parse_path at 0.0254 mm/mil; Shapely intersections of recorded exclusion boundaries. Areas are geometric planning envelopes, not free placement area.
limits: No component courtyard/body, FPC fold, mounting/assembly/tool access, signal/power/return channel or tolerance deduction; no free-area or routability claim.
Recorded copper exclusions are planning context, not universally interchangeable with body-placement keepouts.
Native arcs are sampled by the existing parser; compare area against the independent saved Gerber/CAD report.
Offline R21 snapshot only; no live EDA changes or new DRC/DFM execution.
